description: Send a message in an existing conversation. Accepts room_name (from list_conversations) or talent_slug (from search_talent). Use start_conversation first if no conversation exists yet. The candidate reads it as coming from the user's company, so show the user the exact text and get their OK before sending. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

title: Send message to candidate
